block-guide:
CORE/QUERY-PAGINATION "Previous / 1 2 3 / Next" links for a core/query list; it stands inside core/query, after the post-template. Read the core/query guide for the whole list.
MARKUP (comments only: none of these blocks has HTML of its own) <!-- wp:query-pagination {"layout":{"type":"flex","justifyContent":"space-between"}} --> <!-- wp:query-pagination-previous /--> <!-- wp:query-pagination-numbers /--> <!-- wp:query-pagination-next /--> <!-- /wp:query-pagination --> Any of the three may be left out. previous/next take "label" for their text.
BEHAVIOR It shows only when the query has more posts than perPage. The page number travels in the address as ?query-<queryId>-page=2 (with inherit:false), or as the archive's own /page/2/ (inherit:true).
